_help: Pictures visitors can choose from when they write you a postcard. Files live in images/postcard-options/. Removing an option here does not delete postcards already sent with it (they fall back to the first option).

entries.alt: A tree-lined road under a pale evening sky.
An ornate pavilion with red and gold pillars.
A white house and pool under a blue evening sky.
A painted coastline dotted with lights.
A print of curling blue waves.
A staircase glowing pink and yellow.
